# pmax — Digital marketing agency in Mallorca

> pmax (PMax Online S.L.) is a digital marketing agency based in Calvià, Mallorca, Spain. We run performance marketing programmes — Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, SEO and AI search visibility — for brands across Europe. We charge flat monthly fees, not a percentage of media spend. Our clients are typically businesses with monthly ad budgets of €5,000–€200,000 seeking measurable, compounding growth.

## Who we are

pmax was founded by Philipp Enders. The company is registered as PMax Online S.L. (VAT ES B57948123) in Calvià, Mallorca, Spain. We serve clients across Europe from our Mallorca office.

**Contact:** hello@pmax.online | +34 871 242 160
**Address:** Calle Cordova 5, 07184 Calvià, Mallorca, Spain
**Website:** https://pmax.online

## Services we offer

- [AI Search Visibility (GEO)](https://pmax.online/services/ai-visibility/): Making businesses visible in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews and other generative AI surfaces. Schema, content and trust-signal work.
- [Google Ads](https://pmax.online/services/google-ads/): Search, Performance Max, Shopping, Display and YouTube. Profit-aware bidding, clean account structure, CRM-fed offline conversions.
- [Paid Social](https://pmax.online/services/paid-social/): Meta (Facebook, Instagram), LinkedIn, TikTok. Creative-led, audience-first, CAPI and Events API connected.
- [SEO](https://pmax.online/services/seo/): Technical SEO, content strategy, regional SEO, multilingual hreflang, E-E-A-T and structured data.
- [Conversion Design (CRO)](https://pmax.online/services/conversion-design/): Landing page optimisation, multi-step form design, booking flow rebuilds, A/B testing.
- [Analytics & Tracking](https://pmax.online/services/analytics/): Server-side GTM, Consent Mode v2, GA4 setup, offline conversion imports, CRM integrations.
- [Creative Production](https://pmax.online/services/creative/): Ad creative at volume — video, static, UGC — for Meta, TikTok and YouTube.

## Industries we specialise in

- **E-commerce** (Shopify, WooCommerce, Shopware, Magento — DTC, marketplace, omni-channel)
- **Real estate** (valuation lead gen, portal optimisation, agencies in Mallorca, Madrid, Berlin, Vienna)
- **Healthcare** (DTC clinics, telehealth, aesthetic medicine — regulator-aware, GDPR-compliant)
- **Renewables & cleantech** (solar installers, heat pumps, EV charging — long-cycle B2B lead gen)
- **Boating & yachting** (charter, brokerage, marinas — seasonal, multilingual, Med-focused)
- **HR & recruiting** (B2B SaaS, employer branding, LinkedIn-led demand generation)
- **Retail** (multi-location, Local Inventory Ads, franchise networks)
- **Automotive** (dealer groups, EV brands, brand-lift campaigns)
- **Energy** (B2B utilities, demand response, long sales cycles)
- **Hospitality** (hotels, resorts, direct-booking growth, OTA dependency reduction)

- [Luxaflex franchise network](https://pmax.online/cases/luxaflex/): −93% cost per lead, +3,191% contact requests over three years via local paid search.

- [IMERO e-label (SaaS)](https://pmax.online/cases/imero/): −60% CPC, +307% sign-ups via Google Ads rebuild across 11 languages.
- [PRIMUNDUS (healthcare SEO)](https://pmax.online/cases/primundus/): +535% impressions, +182% clicks through regional SEO for a German 24-hour care provider.
- [Unisono Luxury Homes (real estate)](https://pmax.online/cases/unisono/): +183% phone leads, +138% CTR via multi-channel programme in Mallorca.
- [B2B energy utility](https://pmax.online/cases/energy-utility/): +31% organic impressions, +52% paid conversions for a listed German energy company.
- [Gabiona (e-commerce)](https://pmax.online/cases/gabionas/): +27% Google Ads revenue, +33% AOV at the same budget across five European markets.
- [PREO Software AG](https://pmax.online/cases/preo/): +72% organic clicks, +143% page-1 keywords via content-led SEO for a niche B2B category.

## How we work

- Flat monthly retainer fees — no percentage of media spend, no conflicting incentives
- All media spend is paid directly to platforms by the client — pmax does not handle client budgets
- Multilingual capability: English, German, Spanish — campaigns run in up to 19 languages
- Server-side tracking, Consent Mode v2, GDPR and LOPDGDD compliant by default
- 93% twelve-month client retention rate
- First conversation: 30 minutes, free, no pitch
